title: Echo: Scaling Visual Reinforcement Learning with Off-policy Experience
abstract: arXiv:2610.37865v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scaling visual reinforcement learning (RL) with GPU-accelerated simulation is computationally expensive due to rendering and visual-policy inference costs. Consequently, two-stage teacher--student distillation is commonly used to train visual policies, but introduces an imitation gap. In this preliminary study, we introduce \echomethod{}, \textbf{a single-stage off-policy RL framework that scales experience collection without proportionally increasing visual computation}. Through \textbf{inverse distillation}, a state-based auxiliary policy imitates the evolving visual policy and collects inexpensive, unrendered experience. Echo leverages this experience for off-policy value learning, directly improving the visual policy through a shared privileged critic. We instantiate \echomethod{} with FastTD3 and evaluate it on three visual control tasks and two dexterous manipulation tasks in Genesis. Relative to \sdpgmethod{} under the evaluated

translated_title: Echo：利用离线策略经验扩展视觉强化学习
translated_abstract: 由于渲染和视觉策略推理的开销，使用GPU加速仿真来扩展视觉强化学习（RL）的计算成本十分高昂。因此，两阶段的师生蒸馏方法通常被用于训练视觉策略，但这会引入模仿差距。在这项初步研究中，我们提出了Echo方法，这是一个单阶段的离线策略强化学习框架，能够在不成比例增加视觉计算量的情况下扩展经验收集。通过逆向蒸馏，一个基于状态的辅助策略模仿不断演化的视觉策略，并收集低成本的、无需渲染的经验。Echo利用这些经验进行离线价值学习，通过共享的特权评论家直接改进视觉策略。我们使用FastTD3实例化Echo，并在Genesis仿真环境中通过三个视觉控制任务和两个灵巧手操作任务对其进行评估。相对于在评估条件下的SDPG方法……
tldr: Echo提出了一种单阶段离线策略强化学习框架，通过逆向蒸馏让基于状态的辅助策略收集无需渲染的低成本经验，从而在不成比例增加视觉计算量的情况下扩展视觉强化学习的经验收集，并借助共享的特权评论家直接改进视觉策略。
en_tdlr: Echo introduces a single-stage off-policy RL framework that uses inverse distillation to let a state-based auxiliary policy collect inexpensive unrendered experience, scaling experience collection for visual RL without proportionally increasing visual computation, while directly improving the visual policy through a shared privileged critic.
